notes: New: A Contracts page where you can write rental agreements and choose which property each one is for.
New: Send a contract from a booking, email it to the guest, and have them sign it on screen with a finger, pen or mouse.
New: Create an invoice for a booking, then print it or email it to the guest.
New: A sample rental agreement is included so you can start from something ready-made.
New: Bookings can now record children, pets and the guest's arrival time.
New: When you save a booking, you can go straight on to sending a contract or an invoice.
Improved: A booking's page now shows the contract and invoice status, and the extra guest details.
